csv_project_name: Light Rail Systems Asset Mgmt Gap Assessment plan
csv_scope_of_work: The Regional Transportation District (RTD) is seeking a qualified firm with light rail systems engineering and asset management experience to utilize the Federal Transit Administration (FTA) Transit Asset Management Systems Handbook (Guidance) to evaluate RTD s light rail systems asset information against the framework in the Guidance, and to create a set of actionable recommendations for achieving conformance to the Guidance. The evaluation of the present state of information compared to the FTA Guidance shall be referred to as a gap assessment in the remainder of this statement of work. The set of actionable recommendations to achieve the quality and completeness of information consistent with the Guidance will be referred to as the plan. There will be two deliverables requested of the selected firm: (1) the gap assessment and (2) the plan to achieve compliance to the Guidance. Proposals shall include a description of the gap assessment methodology, including the types of records and physical access that may be necessary to conduct the assessment.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, ITS Design
